title: Notch Manual 2026.2 — Creative Systems Locator Manifest
rightsBoundary: This manifest stores URLs, source metadata, and short original capability statements only. It does not mirror manual text, images, binaries, example code, or bundled assets.
userSuppliedCoverage: Every supplied official 2026.2 Manual node locator is preserved losslessly in user-supplied-locator-ledger.json. The family records in notch-capability-pack.json are grounded only in the source references named for them; unparsed leaf links remain locators for a future bounded extraction and are not implementation evidence.

sources.coverage: Observed index of node families, including 2D, 3D, cloning, deformers, fields, generators, materials, modifiers, particles, Post-FX, rendering, shading, sound, scripting, and video.
Observed execution ordering: top-to-bottom, then left-to-right for nodes at the same height.
Observed asset model: embedded node systems with a simplified parameter surface can be saved and shared with resources.
Observed custom-shader boundary: HLSL in .fx resources using D3DX Effect; 2026.2 adds custom particle affectors, cloner effectors, and deformers.
Observed first ONNX implementation: the AI Model Post-FX supports image-to-image models; compatibility depends on model, GPU architecture, drivers, and production testing.
Observed renderer intent boundary: NURA keeps material and lighting intent while render-node choice trades quality for performance.
Observed external control surface: exposed values can cover text, numbers, transforms, cameras, arrays, and video; the host overwrites exposed property values.
Observed host-side block QA: exposed controls, viewport, VRAM, frame render time, and effective frame rate.
User-supplied generator locators: Voronoi, Truchet, Sound Texture, Radial Vortex, Hilbert Curve, MIDI To Texture, and Fractal Noise.

User-supplied field locators: feedback, derivative feedback, procedural, fluid, image, points, primitive, turbulence, velocity, vortex, curl noise, collisions, image/mesh/particle/primitive/procedural emitters, reaction-diffusion, field rendering, and cloud/flame/pyro/colour-ramp materials.
User-supplied deformer locators: colour/material, cloth/rope, points, splines/lines, topology, weights, vertex transforms, UV generation, and Voronoi fracture.
Observed index coverage of particle roots, emitters, affectors, weights, shading, and renderers.
Observed index coverage of blur, feedback, colour, distortion, image processing, stylisation, warping, and custom shader post effects.

User-supplied materials, lighting, shading, and rendering category locators; the Nodes index identifies glass, metallic, subsurface, diffuse, emissive, and shadow-catcher materials plus ambient, area, directional, omni, sky, and spot lighting.
User-supplied modifiers, interactive, logic, sound, scripting, video, text-FX, motion-capture, layers, exposed-node, and node-utility category locators.
